entries.title: C0120 original-source scope correction (draft)
entries.statement: DRAFT source correction: For independent standard Gaussian weights g_v on Z_+^2, let M_n=max_p sum_{v in p}g_v over all n-vertex up/right paths starting at (0,0), with endpoint free. Improve Chatterjee's Var(M_n)<=C n/log n to Var(M_n)<=C_epsilon n^(1-epsilon) for some epsilon>0 independent of n>=2. This is the concrete power-improvement formulation of Section 12(3) in the Section 8 model. The general-dimensional fixed-temperature log Z_n problem is a separate related formulation, supported for nearly gamma disorder by Alexander-Zygouras arXiv:1204.1819; it is not the observable in the cited Chatterjee theorem. Current openness is UNKNOWN.

entries.title: Polynomial OU overlap implies a variance power improvement (draft)
entries.statement: DRAFT conditional deduction awaiting review. In the model: n>=2; Lambda_n={(i,j):i,j>=0,i+j<n}; independent standard Gaussian vertex weights; n-vertex up/right paths from (0,0), endpoint free; M_n=max path sum and P_n its a.s. unique maximizer. Let g^t=e^(-t)g+sqrt(1-e^(-2t))g', g' independent, h_n(t)=E|P_n(g) intersect P_n(g^t)|. Var(M_n)=integral_0^infinity e^(-t)h_n(t)dt, h_n is nonincreasing, and h_n(n^(-alpha))<=C n^(1-delta), with fixed C,alpha,delta>0, implies Var(M_n)<=(1+C)n^(1-min(alpha,delta)). The overlap hypothesis is not proved.
assumptions: n>=2; Lambda_n={(i,j):i,j>=0,i+j<n}; independent standard Gaussian vertex weights; n-vertex up/right paths from (0,0), endpoint free; M_n=max path sum and P_n its a.s. unique maximizer.
Fixed C,alpha,delta independent of n; stated overlap hypothesis

entries.title: Per-site Gaussian hypercontractivity envelope (draft)
entries.statement: DRAFT source specialization. In the model: n>=2; Lambda_n={(i,j):i,j>=0,i+j<n}; independent standard Gaussian vertex weights; n-vertex up/right paths from (0,0), endpoint free; M_n=max path sum and P_n its a.s. unique maximizer. Let q_v=P(v in P_n), a(t)=tanh(t/2), and g^t=e^(-t)g+sqrt(1-e^(-2t))g' with independent g'. Chatterjee Lemma 4.1 gives E|P_n(g) intersect P_n(g^t)|<=B_n(t):=sum_v q_v^(1+a(t)). Site indicators need not be independent.
assumptions: n>=2; Lambda_n={(i,j):i,j>=0,i+j<n}; independent standard Gaussian vertex weights; n-vertex up/right paths from (0,0), endpoint free; M_n=max path sum and P_n its a.s. unique maximizer.

entries.title: A lower bound on the hypercontractive certificate, not the variance (draft)
entries.statement: DRAFT deduction awaiting review. For n>=2 and any q_v>=0 on Lambda_n={(i,j):i,j>=0,i+j<n} with sum_{i+j=k}q_v=1 on every layer, set B_n(t)=sum_v q_v^(1+tanh(t/2)). Jensen gives B_n(t)>=sum_{k=1}^n k^(-tanh(t/2))>=n^(1-tanh(t/2)), integral_0^infinity e^(-t)B_n(t)dt>=(n-1)/log n, and B_n(n^(-alpha))/n->1 for fixed alpha>0. This prevents this certificate from certifying a variance power improvement. It gives no lower bound on actual overlap or variance.
assumptions: Nonnegative layer probabilities of mass one
Only the direct unweighted per-site certificate is assessed

entries.title: Conditional KPZ threshold correction: xi<3/4 (draft)
entries.statement: DRAFT algebraic correction. Assume Var(F_n)=n^(2chi+o(1)) and chi=2xi-1 for the same model. Var(F_n)<=C n^(1-epsilon), epsilon>0 fixed, requires xi<=3/4-epsilon/4. xi<1 alone is insufficient: xi=4/5 yields variance exponent 6/5. These statements do not establish the KPZ relation for polymers.
assumptions: KPZ relation chi=2xi-1 assumed for this model

relations.rationale: The source correction's M_n is defined by the Gaussian up/right free-endpoint model.
The overlap identity needs the finite independent Gaussian path model and a.s. unique maximizer.
Gaussian OU hypercontractivity is applied to the path-incidence indicators in this model.
L3 evaluates precisely B_n(t)=sum_v q_v^(1+tanh(t/2)) from the envelope card.
The barrier's certificate floor (n-1)/log n refutes using this direct certificate to certify a fixed power improvement; it does not refute the target variance bound.
Both distinguish a needed positive power gap from a weaker asymptotic or exponent statement; the KPZ relation is a separate conditional route.
The existing card attributes 'Var(log Z_n)' in 'general dimension' to Section 12(3); this draft records the source-model discrepancy.
Uses standard Gaussian OU coupling e^(-t)g+sqrt(1-e^(-2t))g' and L2 self-adjoint contraction in the existing Mehler card.
